name: Economic Demography
summary: Research studies how family decisions, population change, and social norms shape education, health, labor, and household welfare.
overview: The agenda includes son preference, fertility, women’s health and safety, marriage timing, and intergenerational behavior within households.

projects.title: Beyond Fertility: Son Preference and Women’s Health in Nepal
projects.summary: Examines the relationship between son preference, fertility behavior, and maternal health in Nepal.

projects.title: Push and Pull Factors for (Early) Marriage, Bangladesh Integrated Household Survey Questionnaire (BIHS)
projects.summary: Uses the Bangladesh Integrated Household Survey to investigate factors associated with marriage timing.
